content:
I have created a gist which is a start of my formalization of the "Time Hybrids" book of Fred Van Oystaeyen. It is a book about a generic framework of reality where both relativity theory and quantum theory are specializations of. Fred is an outstanding mathematician (among others in non-commutative algebraic geometry). See, for example, his "Virtual Topology and Functor Geometry" book.

See https://gist.github.com/LucDuponcheelAtGitHub/974359f6f527decc0fb6d6c4e3204c39.

Below is the code of the gist.

All comments are welcome.

Code listing

import Mathlib.CategoryTheory.Category.Basic
import Mathlib.CategoryTheory.Functor.Basic
import Mathlib.CategoryTheory.Types.Basic

open CategoryTheory

-- For uniformity reasons I define CategoryMonad similar to CategoryZero, CategoryChoices.
structure CategoryMonad (C : Type u) [Category.{v} C] (F : C ⥤ C) where
  η : 𝟭 C ⟶ F
  μ : F ⋙ F ⟶ F
  assoc :
    ∀ X,
      F.map (μ.app X) ≫ μ.app X =
        μ.app (F.obj X) ≫ μ.app X := by aesop_cat
  left_unit :
    ∀ X,
      η.app (F.obj X) ≫ μ.app X =
        𝟙 (F.obj X) := by aesop_cat
  right_unit :
    ∀ X,
      F.map (η.app X) ≫ μ.app X =
        𝟙 (F.obj X) := by aesop_cat

structure CategoryZero (C : Type u) [Category.{v} C] (F : C ⥤ C) where
  ζ : F ⟶ F

structure CategoryChoices (C : Type u) [Category.{v} C] (F : C ⥤ C) where
  χ : F ⋙ F ⟶ F ⋙ F

structure CategorySup (C : Type u) (HasSup : C → Type*) [Category.{v} C] (F : C ⥤ C) where
  σ {T : C} (_ : HasSup T) : F.obj T ⟶ T

-- uu and vu are the universes for the category Universe
universe uu vu

-- um and vm are the universes for the category Matter
universe um vm

class Reality
  {Universe : Type uu} [Category.{vu} Universe]
  {Matter : Type um} [Category.{vm} Matter]
where
  U : Universe

  toPrePlaceFunctor : Universe ⥤ Universe
  toPreThingCollectionFunctor : Universe ⥤ Matter

  toMatterFunctor : Universe ⥤ Matter

  preThingCollectionToPrePlace :
    toPreThingCollectionFunctor.obj U ⟶ toMatterFunctor.obj (toPrePlaceFunctor.obj U)

  matterAndCollectionFunctor : Matter ⥤ Matter
  matterAndCollectionMonad : CategoryMonad Matter matterAndCollectionFunctor
  matterAndCollectionZero : CategoryZero Matter matterAndCollectionFunctor
  matterAndCollectionChoices : CategoryChoices Matter matterAndCollectionFunctor

  HasSup : Matter → Type*
  matterAndCollectionSup : CategorySup Matter HasSup matterAndCollectionFunctor

  universeTransitionOrder : LE (U ⟶ U)

  toPrePlaceOrder {T : Matter} : LE (T ⟶ toMatterFunctor.obj (toPrePlaceFunctor.obj U))
  toPreThingCollectionOrder {T : Matter} : LE (T ⟶ toPreThingCollectionFunctor.obj U)

  PreThing : Matter
  preThingCollectionAsPreThing : toPreThingCollectionFunctor.obj U ⟶ PreThing

  isToPreInteraction {T : Matter} : (T ⟶ toPreThingCollectionFunctor.obj U) → Prop
  isToOne {T : Matter} : (T ⟶ toPreThingCollectionFunctor.obj U) → Prop

  forEveryToPreThingCollectionsProp {T : Matter} :
    ((T ⟶ toPreThingCollectionFunctor.obj U) → Prop) →
      ((T ⟶ (matterAndCollectionFunctor.obj (toPreThingCollectionFunctor.obj U))) → Prop)

  isMovementAt : (U ⟶ U) →
    (universeToMatterPrePlaceFunctor : Universe ⥤ Matter) →
      (universeToMatterPrePlaceFunctor.obj U =
      toMatterFunctor.obj (toPrePlaceFunctor.obj U)) → Prop :=
      fun universeTransition universeToMatterPrePlaceFunctor h ↦
        let universePrePlaceTransition :=
          toPrePlaceFunctor.map universeTransition
        let matterPreThingCollectionTransition :=
          toPreThingCollectionFunctor.map universeTransition
        let matterPrePlaceTransition :=
          h ▸ universeToMatterPrePlaceFunctor.map universeTransition
        preThingCollectionToPrePlace ≫ toMatterFunctor.map universePrePlaceTransition =
          matterPreThingCollectionTransition ≫ preThingCollectionToPrePlace ≫
            matterPrePlaceTransition

  isImmobileAt : (U ⟶ U) → Prop :=
    fun universeTransition ↦
      isMovementAt universeTransition {
        obj := fun _ ↦ toMatterFunctor.obj (toPrePlaceFunctor.obj U)
        map := fun _ ↦ 𝟙 (toMatterFunctor.obj (toPrePlaceFunctor.obj U))
        map_id := fun _ ↦ rfl
        map_comp := fun _ _ ↦ (Category.id_comp _).symm } rfl

  isMovement :
    (universeToMatterPrePlaceFunctor : Universe ⥤ Matter) →
      (universeToMatterPrePlaceFunctor.obj U =
      toMatterFunctor.obj (toPrePlaceFunctor.obj U)) → Prop :=
        fun universeToMatterPrePlaceFunctor h ↦
          ∀ universeTransition,
            isMovementAt universeTransition universeToMatterPrePlaceFunctor h

  isImmobile : Prop := ∀ universeTransition, isImmobileAt universeTransition

  isUniformMovementAt : (U ⟶ U) →
    ∀ (universeToMatterPrePlaceFunctor : Universe ⥤ Matter),
      (universeToMatterPrePlaceFunctor.obj U =
      toMatterFunctor.obj (toPrePlaceFunctor.obj U)) → Prop :=
      fun universeTransition universeToMatterPrePlaceFunctor h ↦
        ∀ subUniverseTransition,
          subUniverseTransition ≤ universeTransition →
            isMovementAt subUniverseTransition universeToMatterPrePlaceFunctor h

  isUniformImmobileAt : (U ⟶ U) → Prop :=
    fun universeTransition ↦
      ∀ subUniverseTransition,
        subUniverseTransition ≤ universeTransition → isImmobileAt subUniverseTransition

  isUniformMovement :
    ∀ (universeToMatterPrePlaceFunctor : Universe ⥤ Matter),
      (universeToMatterPrePlaceFunctor.obj U =
      toMatterFunctor.obj (toPrePlaceFunctor.obj U)) → Prop :=
        fun universeToMatterPrePlaceFunctor h ↦
          ∀ universeTransition,
            isUniformMovementAt universeTransition universeToMatterPrePlaceFunctor h

  isUniformImmobile : Prop :=
    ∀ universeTransition : U ⟶ U, isUniformImmobileAt universeTransition

  thereIsNoEscapeFromZeroTransition :
    (matterAndCollectionFunctor.obj PreThing =
      toPreThingCollectionFunctor.obj U) → Prop :=
        fun h ↦
          ∀ universeTransition : U ⟶ U,
            let preThingCollectionTransition :=
              toPreThingCollectionFunctor.map universeTransition
            let zeroTransition :=
              h ▸ matterAndCollectionZero.ζ.app PreThing
            zeroTransition ≫ preThingCollectionTransition = zeroTransition

  preInteractionPreservation {T : Matter} : Prop :=
    ∀ toPreThingCollection : T ⟶ toPreThingCollectionFunctor.obj U,
    ∀ universeTransition : U ⟶ U,
      isToPreInteraction toPreThingCollection →
        isToPreInteraction
          (toPreThingCollection ≫ toPreThingCollectionFunctor.map universeTransition)

  orderPreservation {T : Matter} : Prop :=
    ∀ leftToPreThingsMatterAssociation rightToPreThingsMatterAssociation :
      T ⟶ toPreThingCollectionFunctor.obj U,
      leftToPreThingsMatterAssociation ≤ rightToPreThingsMatterAssociation →
        leftToPreThingsMatterAssociation ≫ preThingCollectionToPrePlace ≤
          rightToPreThingsMatterAssociation ≫ preThingCollectionToPrePlace

  toOneProperty {T : Matter} :
    (h : matterAndCollectionFunctor.obj PreThing =
      toPreThingCollectionFunctor.obj U) → Prop :=
        fun h ↦
          ∀ toPreThingCollection : T ⟶ toPreThingCollectionFunctor.obj U,
            let oneTransition := h ▸ matterAndCollectionMonad.η.app PreThing
            isToOne toPreThingCollection ↔
              toPreThingCollection ≫ preThingCollectionAsPreThing ≫ oneTransition =
                toPreThingCollection

  supremumOfPrePlacesOfSubsets (inst : HasSup (toMatterFunctor.obj (toPrePlaceFunctor.obj U))) :
    (h : matterAndCollectionFunctor.obj PreThing =
      toPreThingCollectionFunctor.obj U) → Prop :=
        fun h ↦
          ∀ prePlaceOfCollectionOfPreThings :
            toPreThingCollectionFunctor.obj U ⟶ toMatterFunctor.obj (toPrePlaceFunctor.obj U),
          (h ▸ (matterAndCollectionFunctor.map (h.symm ▸ prePlaceOfCollectionOfPreThings))) ≫
            matterAndCollectionSup.σ inst =
          (h ▸ matterAndCollectionMonad.μ.app PreThing) ≫ prePlaceOfCollectionOfPreThings

  preInteractionCollectionAsOneJoinOfChoices {T : Matter} :
    (h : matterAndCollectionFunctor.obj PreThing =
      toPreThingCollectionFunctor.obj U) → Prop :=
        fun h ↦
          ∀ toPreThingCollectionCollection :
            T ⟶ matterAndCollectionFunctor.obj (toPreThingCollectionFunctor.obj U),
          (forEveryToPreThingCollectionsProp isToPreInteraction) toPreThingCollectionCollection →
            toPreThingCollectionCollection ≫ (h ▸ matterAndCollectionChoices.χ.app PreThing) ≫
              (h ▸ matterAndCollectionMonad.μ.app PreThing) ≫
                matterAndCollectionMonad.η.app (toPreThingCollectionFunctor.obj U) =
                  toPreThingCollectionCollection
